notes.title: Seaside Driving page is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41617121/08575e5b9bef6b03cf920c7a35e4a80302bd246a.png[/img]

[b]Tendokore[/b] together with [b]Frozen Lake Games[/b] is pleased to announce that the [b]Seaside Driving [/b]game is coming soon to PC!

[i]Chill & drive 80's style. Get into your car and cruise endlessly while listening to synthwave tracks.[/i]

[previewyoutube=Wxn2cf3rleU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]About Frozen Lake Games:[/b]
Frozen Lake Games, previously known as “Sakis25 Games,” is an indie games developer from Greece. He started programming as a hobby in early 2005 with Game Maker, was one of the first developers focused on 3D games using this engine.
[url=https://www.frozenlake-games.com/]https://www.frozenlake-games.com/[/url]

[b]About Tendokore:[/b]
Tendokore is a retro-inspired indie games publisher founded in 2021 focused on single-player experiences influenced by early PC and console classics.
[url=https://www.tendokore.com/]https://www.tendokore.com/[/url]
